statements.JinWishart.candidate_actual_eigenvalue_s: (p L q : ℕ) (lambda : Fin L → ℝ) (hl : StrictMono lambda) (hlp : ∀ j, 0 < lambda j) (M : Matrix (Fin (p+L+q)) (Fin (p+L)) ℂ) (hmean : (∑ a : Fin (p+L+q) × Fin (p+L), ‖M a.1 a.2‖^2) = ∑ j : Fin L, lambda j) : (mixedCandidateEnsemble p L q lambda).map (fun z => ∑ i, z i) = (stdGaussian (ComplexSample (m := p+L+q) (n := p+L))).map (fun z => ∑ i, complexNoncentralSampleEigenvalue M i z)
statements.JinWishart.meanPositiveNoncentrality_sum: {m n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) : (∑ i : Fin M.rank, meanPositiveNoncentrality M i) = ∑ a : Fin m × Fin n, ‖M a.1 a.2‖^2
statements.JinWishart.candidate_actual_eigenvalue_s: (p L q : ℕ) (lambda : Fin L → ℝ) (hl : StrictMono lambda) (hlp : ∀ j, 0 < lambda j) (M : Matrix (Fin (p+L+q)) (Fin (p+L)) ℂ) (e : Fin L ≃ Fin M.rank) (hparam : ∀ j, lambda j = meanPositiveNoncentrality M (e j)) : (mixedCandidateEnsemble p L q lambda).map (fun z => ∑ i, z i) = (stdGaussian (ComplexSample (m := p+L+q) (n := p+L))).map (fun z => ∑ i, complexNoncentralSampleEigenvalue M i z)
